A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Questions?
Let’s clear them up.

Our team is here to help.

+1 814-254-7767 ↗
Can I choose which days I work?

This role requires daily work Monday through Sunday, including weekends, with no scheduled days off. You can choose your working hours within each day.

Do I need Facebook experience?

Familiarity with Facebook groups and creating posts is helpful. We welcome different experience levels and ask about your comfort with posting, editing listings, and following group rules.

When will I receive a decision?

Our team aims to respond within two days of receiving your application. You must be approved before beginning the three trials.

Is this a permanent position?

No. This is a temporary position. We provide one to two weeks’ notice before the work ends.

How is pay handled?

The ongoing role pays $600 per week. Your first payday is seven days after starting the ongoing role, then weekly. Trial terms are provided before trial assignments begin.

What equipment do I need?

A phone or computer, Facebook access, and a reliable internet connection. You should be able to check assignment updates and communicate consistently.

How do I send my application?

Complete the six-step form and review your answers. Choose “Prepare application email” to open a draft addressed to Alderive. Send it from your email app, or download your answers and email them to infoprivateproperty.holdings@gmail.com.
